The Pricing & Tender Coordinator DACH will manage pricing and tender processes within the life sciences industry, ensuring accuracy and compliance. This role is focused on delivering high-quality customer service support.

Client Details

Our client is an international company active in medical supplies and accessories.

They are looking for a temporary (but with probability of becoming permanent) Tender & Pricing Coordinator who is fluent in German and English.

Description

As a Pricing & Tender Coordinator DACH you will have two main pillars:

 

1) Pricing

 

• You analyse pricing strategies and habits in your markets and develop the company's pricing structure
• You make sure prices get approved and implemented
• You communicate new price quotations to your customers
• You are responsible for implementing your pricing in SAP
• You update price catalogues
 

2) Tender & Sales Support

 

• You manage tender processes from A to Z (preparation, analyses, contracts, pitches, ...)
• You communicate important contract changes
• You monitor the tender renewals
• You analyze clients complaints regarding contracting and pricing
 

 

 

 

A successful Pricing & Tender Coordinator DACH should have:

• Experience in tender, pricing and customer service or administrative roles
• Knowledge of pricing and tender processes
• Strong organisational and multitasking skills
• Attention to detail and accuracy in handling documents
• Proficiency in IT tools, particularly Excel and SAP
• Fluency in English and German
• Ideally your are immediately available

Industrial investment projects in a process environment

In this role, you lead complex multidisciplinary CAPEX projects within an industrial process setting from start to finish. You retain full responsibility throughout the project lifecycle for scope, budget, timing, quality and safety. The assignment covers both greenfield initiatives and substantial modifications to existing industrial installations.

Key responsibilities

• Lead industrial engineering projects from feasibility and concept phase through commissioning and final handover to operations.
• Set and manage project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and the baseline schedule in MS Project.
• Steer all project stages, including pre-study, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, on-site execution, commissioning and transfer.
• Serve as the main accountable point of contact for stakeholders and management during the full project trajectory.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary internal and external teams across mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS domains.
• Control scope changes, project risks, claims and deviations with impact on cost or planning.
• Provide clear reporting on progress, decisions and issues to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You have at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• You also bring at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You have solid experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval processes and the commissioning of industrial installations.
• Experience in the process industry is required.
• You have strong hands-on expertise in MS Project and are used to building and owning project schedules, not just tracking them.
• You work at academic level and combine strong analytical capabilities with a broad helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work autonomously and take full ownership of your assignments.
• You demonstrate strong leadership and can challenge stakeholders and contractors when necessary.
• You communicate confidently with stakeholders at every organisational level.
• You bring natural authority to complex industrial environments.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

jobs.occupation: Become a Butcher in Wholesale – Quality Meat Processing in Aartselaar
jobs.description:
As a butcher in our wholesale department, you are responsible for expertly processing quality meat for professional customers in Belgium and abroad. You work precisely and efficiently in a modern production environment where craftsmanship is key. Your duties include deboning, cutting, and portioning beef, pork, lamb, and poultry to the specified weights and customer requirements. You also prepare ground meats and charcuterie, conduct quality checks, and ensure products are packaged and labeled correctly.

A typical workday starts early in the morning. You begin at 6:00 am with your close-knit team. Your responsibilities include deboning, cutting, and weighing meat, always paying attention to detail and quality. You follow strict procedures to guarantee food safety and contribute to a smooth production flow. During lunch, you and your colleagues enjoy our house-made meat products, and you finish your workday by 2:00 pm.

Are you a skilled professional who likes to roll up your sleeves and is committed to quality? Apply today and join our team of passionate butchers!

• Thorough knowledge of the complete breakdown and deboning of a beef carcass (very important)

• Skilled at cutting to weight and deboning meat

• Precise and efficient work ethic with a keen eye for detail and quality

• Motivated, reliable, and takes initiative

• Able to work independently and as part of a team

• Good command of English and willing to learn Dutch

• Willing to work occasionally on Saturdays if needed

• Completed lower or higher secondary education

• At least 2 years of experience as a butcher (5–10 years or more is a plus)

Founded in 1948, our client is a Belgian family-owned company specializing in exterior joinery. The group operates several production sites manufacturing aluminium, PVC and wooden windows, doors, garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems. The company is known for its modern production facilities, continuous innovation and long-term investment in employee development.

Jobomschrijving

If you are passionate about technology, eager to learn, and looking to build your career in a modern manufacturing environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Our client is looking for Junior Maintenance Technicians / Electromechanics who have a technical education and are motivated to develop their skills through comprehensive on-the-job training.

Without reliable maintenance, there is no quality! As a Maintenance Technician, you will help ensure the smooth operation of production by performing preventive maintenance, identifying technical issues, and supporting continuous improvements.

During approximately the first year, you will work in a two-shift system (early and late shifts) while completing your training. After your training period, you must be willing to work night shifts as part of the regular production schedule.

We are primarily looking for candidates who:
	
• Have a technical education in Electromechanics, or a related technical field (Bachelor's degree, Associate degree, technical secondary education, or equivalent).	
• Have a basic understanding of mechatronics, including fundamentals of PLC systems, sensors, actuators, electricity, mechanics and pneumatics.	
• Are motivated to learn and develop through practical training in the workplace.	
• Have a hands-on mentality and enjoy solving technical problems.	
• Work accurately and pay attention to safety.	
• Enjoy working in a team and communicate well with colleagues.	
• Have a communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.

Our client, company founded in 1948, is a Belgian family business specializing in exterior joinery. Their  Group covers a range of production units. The business unit Extrusion & Finishing extrudes, anodizes and enamels aluminum profiles. Our client specializes in custom-made exterior joinery in PVC, aluminum and wood. In addition to windows and doors, many additional products are also made, such as garage doors, roller shutters and ventilation systems.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description:

Without solid maintenance, there is no quality! As a maintenance technician, you will be responsible for monitoring wear and tear, tracking faults, analyzing causes, proposing solutions, and optimizing production processes. Your tasks will include:
	
• Routine inspections and preventive maintenance.	
• Risk analysis.	
• Working with top-quality machines and equipment.
By collaborating with external partners, you will have the opportunity to critically assess our client’s processes and advise management and production personnel on improving their machinery park. Working in their team also means continuous development, both individually and as part of a team

Candidate Profile:
	
• Preferred education: Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics, industrial engineering, or equivalent experience.	
• Open to all levels of experience - from junior to experienced specialists.	
• Commitment and practical approach to work.	
• Solid knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics.	
• Curiosity and passion for technology.	
• Attention to accuracy and safety in the workplace.	
• Flexibility and willingness to work in shifts.	
• Precision, attention to detail, and efficiency.	
• Teamwork and communication skills.	
• Openness to participating in the on-call system.	
• Basic/communicative knowledge of Dutch or English.

Our client is an engineering company.

Jobomschrijving

1. IT Infrastructure Governance & Strategy

• Assess business and end-user needs, as well as quality, operational, and security requirements.
• Translate business requirements into IT solutions and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
• Design, maintain, and continuously improve the local IT infrastructure architecture in alignment with business objectives and Group standards.
• Advise management on IT strategy, technology evolution, infrastructure investments, and risk mitigation.
• Monitor emerging technologies and recommend improvements to systems, services, and operational efficiency.
• Ensure compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, licensing, and corporate requirements.

2. User Support & Service Delivery

• Provide technical support to end-users through telephone, e-mail, remote assistance, and face-to-face interventions.
• Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and system-related issues.
• Assist end-users in the effective use of IT equipment, systems, and applications.
• Deliver user guidance and training when required.
• Coordinate with external providers and Group IT teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
• Coordinate with external providers and Group IT teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
• Document support procedures and maintain an up-to-date knowledge base.

3. Infrastructure Operations & Maintenance

• Design, implement, operate, and maintain local IT infrastructure including servers, networks, endpoints, and associated services.
• Ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of IT systems and infrastructure.
• Manage backup, recovery, monitoring, and business continuity mechanisms.
• Perform infrastructure updates, upgrades, patch management, and corrective maintenance activities.
• Maintain accurate technical documentation, inventory records, system configurations, and operational procedures.
• Ensure the smooth operation of all IT services, including network services, endpoint management, printing services, e-mail systems, and security tools.

4. Cybersecurity & Compliance

• Support the development, implementation, maintenance, and monitoring of the cybersecurity policies, procedures, and controls in accordance with legal, regulatory, customer, and Group requirements.
• Continuously assess and improve the security posture of systems, applications, and infrastructure.
• Ensure the effective operation of security solutions, including endpoint protection, access control, monitoring, backup, and recovery systems.
• Contribute to security audits, compliance assessments, and corrective action plans.
• Participate in the management of cybersecurity incidents and crisis situations involving complex infrastructure or software issues.

• A bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
• A minimum of five years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, or a comparable role.
• Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Windows environments, Microsoft 365, Active Directory or Entra ID, networking, endpoint management, backup and recovery, virtualization, and infrastructure monitoring.
• Practical knowledge of cybersecurity controls, vulnerability and patch management, access control, endpoint protection, incident response, and secure infrastructure configuration.
• Experience providing remote and on-site end-user support and managing incidents, service requests, technical documentation, and SLAs.
• Experience managing IT suppliers, licenses, assets, procurement activities, and budget-related processes.
• Experience with ISO 27001 implementation is a strong plus.
• Proven ability to operate independently as a local IT point of contact while collaborating effectively with centralised Group IT functions.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, stakeholder-management, and organisational skills.
• Professional fluency in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an advantage.
• Willingness to participate in an on-call rota and provide support outside standard working hours when required.
• Relevant Microsoft, networking, ITIL, or cybersecurity certifications are considered an advantage.

Our client is a globally renowned law firm with an outstanding reputation across the UK, the US, and international markets. With offices located worldwide, the firm advises leading multinational organizations on complex legal matters across various industries.

Due to continued growth of the Brussels office and an upcoming move to larger premises early next year, the firm is looking to strengthen its support team with an additional Legal Assistant. You will join a collaborative environment and work closely with another experienced Legal Assistant in a duo setup, ensuring seamless support to the legal team.

Jobomschrijving

This position is primarily focused on legal administration and billing support (approximately 90% of the role), with a smaller reception component (approximately 10%).

Legal & Administrative Support

• Manage complex billing processes and prepare client invoices with a high level of accuracy.
• Follow up on billing queries and liaise with lawyers and finance teams when needed.
• Prepare, format, proofread, and finalize legal documents, presentations, and correspondence.
• Manage agendas, schedule meetings, and coordinate appointments.
• Organize travel arrangements and business itineraries.
• Handle document management and maintain electronic filing systems.
• Open new client matters and support conflict check processes.
• Monitor deadlines and assist lawyers with day-to-day administrative requirements.
• Provide support to a Partner, two Counsel, and several Associates within the Antitrust practice.

Reception Support (10%)

• Welcome visitors and clients in a professional and courteous manner.
• Answer and redirect incoming calls when required.
• Support the office with occasional front-desk coverage alongside the wider administrative team.

• Previous experience as a Legal Assistant, Practice Assistant, Legal Secretary, or similar support position within a law firm is essential.
• Proven experience managing legal billing and invoicing processes.
• Strong administrative and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
• Near-native level of English is mandatory.
• Good working knowledge of either French or Dutch (minimum B1 level).
• Comfortable supporting senior legal professionals in a demanding international environment.
• Proactive, resourceful, and capable of anticipating needs before they arise.
• Professional, discreet, and confident in managing confidential information.
• Team-oriented mindset with the ability to work closely in partnership with another Legal Assistant.

Candidates must already be based in Belgium and have the right to work in Belgium. Visa sponsorship cannot be provided for this position.
